title: Jacobs: the abduction program aims at planetary takeover by stealth
summary: Tim Alberino tells of Jacobs: the abduction program aims at planetary takeover by stealth, about ongoing at Earth, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Well, David Jacobs said that the endgame of the abduction program was planetary acquisition by stealth.

plain: Tim Alberino, a researcher speaking on Jesse Michels' podcast, passes on the view of David Jacobs, a researcher of alien abduction reports and author of a book called Walking Among Us. According to Alberino, Jacobs said the endgame of the abductions was taking over the planet by stealth. If true, it would mean the abductions are a quiet plan to take control of Earth.
